objective: 100% measured feasibility first; then median24D, P25, P10, lower MDD, mean, lower turnover
question: Can signal-ranking and replacement changes around three development-selected parents pass the required hard development episode without changing entry, allocation or compliance rules?
hypothesis: Earlier neighborhoods missed a permitted signal/replacement interaction that changes holdings enough to avoid the recurring failure.
alternative: Corporate-action uncertainty and daily allocation constraints dominate all permitted parameter choices; additional search produces no admissible strategy.
controlled: all remaining parameters fixed within each parent family

search.parents: own-candidate DEVELOPMENT leader of each of three previous studies

selection: 100% measured pass and completeness on ALL development and validation; validation median/P25 not worse than baseline; momentum +/-0.05 stability; official unknowns remain blocked
diagnostic_policy: No failed hard-episode candidate may advance. All-new-failed implies immediate final rejection; no full-period financial statistics are invented for unrun candidates.
stop_condition: One bounded384-case feasibility study. If no new hard-episode survivor, seal no-qualified replacement and stop before downstream evaluations. Otherwise retain old full-period gates and stop after frozen evaluations.
prior_exposure: Validation reused for model selection; historical holdout and recent already exposed in earlier rounds, isolated from this search but not pristine.
post_freeze: Only if hard-episode survivors reach downstream evaluation:23holdout,20recent,16seasonal;126rolling forbaseline andnewdiagnostic. No return-based retuning.
